call_points.text: No numeric FY27 guidance; management declined to predict export growth due to geopolitical uncertainty.
CV >6T industry production grew 8.4% in Q1FY27; ZF's CV >6T sales grew 8.6%.
ESC manufacturing starts Q3 next year; localisation near 40-50% now, above 75% by SOP.
OEM commodity and FX cost recovery typically lags two quarters; this time it has taken longer than usual.
July 2026 heavy vehicle production averaged 40,000-42,000 units, about 10,000 higher than a typical July.
Board approved Rakesh Mishra as CFO effective September 1, 2026, succeeding Sweta Agarwal.
US and Europe markets declined about 10% YoY, though the US is now ramping up.
EV bus penetration in India is projected to grow from 6% in 2024 to 30% by 2030, supported by government schemes like PM E-Drive.
The company operates six manufacturing plants and two engineering centres across India, with strong localization capabilities.

operating_notes.text: Aluminum commodity costs represent 15% to 18% of raw material requirements.
Aftermarket sales were ₹158.4 Cr in Q1FY27, up 15.6% YoY, with a highest-ever monthly aftermarket sale of ₹63.06 Cr in June 2026.
ESC localisation is near 40-50% now and guided above 75% by SOP, with manufacturing to start in Q3 next year.
Aluminium rose from about ₹260/kg to over ₹360/kg, easing about ₹25 in July 2026.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,155.23 Cr (+14.2% YoY), net profit ₹146.32 Cr (+15.5% YoY).
C V Kavviya, ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India Limited, uploaded Q4 FY2025-26 and FY2025-26 earnings call recording on May 15, 2026.
In May 2026, ZF CV Control Systems announced a 5:1 bonus issue and an increase in authorised share capital to ₹60 Cr.
ZF CVCS India reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹1,197 Cr, recommended a 5:1 bonus issue, and announced a final dividend of ₹4/share.
ZF CVCS India hosted an investor presentation detailing its growth strategy, EV capabilities, and upcoming safety regulations.
WABCO Asia Private Limited, via Pang Lee Come, declared no encumbered shares in ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India Limited as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI Regulation 31(4).
